title: Last Call for Pickles
story: The county fair office stops taking entries at five o'clock on the eve of the fair, and this year four last-minute exhibitors came puffing up the steps an hour apart, starting at one. The clerk stamped every entry, listened politely to Otis's off-key sea shanty, and then knocked a lemonade across the entry sheet. The judges arrive at eight tomorrow morning. Who brought which entry, and at what time?

texts: The exhibitor with the quilt is either Otis or Hugo.
Hugo entered either the honey or the quilt.
Dev arrived later than the exhibitor with the zucchini.
Dev arrived exactly 2 hours before the exhibitor with the quilt.
Selma arrived later than the exhibitor with the pickles.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 3 means the zucchini cannot be 4 p.m. and Dev cannot be 1 p.m.
Since Dev can still be only 2 p.m., 3 p.m., or 4 p.m., clue 4 means the quilt cannot be 1 p.m., 2 p.m., or 3 p.m. and Dev cannot be 3 p.m. or 4 p.m.
Dev must go with 2 p.m.: clue 3 rules out 1 p.m.; clue 4 rules out 3 p.m. and 4 p.m.
The quilt must go with 4 p.m.: clue 4 rules out 1 p.m., 2 p.m., and 3 p.m.
Since the zucchini can still be only 1 p.m. or 3 p.m. and Dev can still be only 2 p.m., clue 3 means the zucchini cannot be 3 p.m.
The zucchini must go with 1 p.m.: clue 3 rules out 3 p.m. and 4 p.m.; 2 p.m. is already ruled out for Dev.
Since Selma can still be only 1 p.m. or 3 p.m. and the pickles can still be only 2 p.m. or 3 p.m., clue 5 means Selma cannot be 1 p.m. and the pickles cannot be 3 p.m.
Selma must go with 3 p.m.: clue 5 rules out 1 p.m.; 4 p.m. is already ruled out for the quilt; 2 p.m. already goes with Dev.
Hugo must go with 4 p.m.: 1 p.m. is already ruled out for the zucchini; the other choices are already taken.
Otis must go with 1 p.m.: the other choices are already taken.
The pickles must go with 2 p.m.: clue 5 rules out 3 p.m.; the other choices are already taken.
The honey must go with 3 p.m.: the other choices are already taken.
Dev goes with 2 p.m., so Dev also goes with the pickles.
The quilt goes with 4 p.m., so the quilt also goes with Hugo.
Selma must go with the honey: clue 5 rules out the pickles; clue 1 rules out the quilt; the zucchini is already ruled out for 1 p.m.
Otis must go with the zucchini: the other choices are already taken.
